title: Wires, Chips & Kiro.d
summary: Sucked into your computer empty-handed, listen to Kiro.d explain your chapter mission, receive your terminal, then practice ls, mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~, cat kiro_story.txt, ps, and kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1} (basic ls works for visible files; ls -la and flags unlock with your Tube Transistor in Sector 02!).

files.content:
=== KIRO.D // CHAPTER MISSION & SURVIVAL BRIEFING ===
1. YOUR CHAPTER GOAL: Raid 6 sectors for hardware, visit the Matrix Server Hub 3 times so the Old Bearded Coder can reboot Kiro.d with open-weight models (silencing Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork), then defeat Clod + PID 1 and run `exit` to return home!
2. TOOLS & TUBE TRANSISTOR GATE: You dropped your Tube Transistor, Map, and Field Manual. Basic `ls` shows visible files in the room, while `ls -la` and all `ls` flags stay locked until you recover your glowing Tube Transistor in Sector 02 (Cache Vault)!
3. SURVIVAL COMMANDS HERE: `ls`, `mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`, `cat kiro_story.txt`, `ps`, `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`, `cd hub_uplink`.
4. SECRET VRAM MODULE: a spare VRAM module hides in the dot folder `.old_archive` of this room, a huge pile of old folders. Plain `ls` never shows dot folders, but `cd .old_archive` works: follow the notes in `lost_and_found`. Or search the pile: `find / -name vram.mod`, `grep -r vram .`. Each module adds a spare charge for Kiro.d skills later!
LOST & FOUND: anything worth keeping was moved to the `back_room` shelf. Go in with `cd back_room`.
BACK ROOM: the memory module is in the dot folder `.cold_storage` right here. Plain `ls` hides it, but `cd .cold_storage` works!

winRules.description: Practice `mv` by pocketing the starter RAM stick (`mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`)
Read Kiro.d's story of the Big Four (`cat kiro_story.txt`)
Practice `ps` and `kill` to zap glitch_spark.exe (`ps` then `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`)

arrival.text:
[DARK WIRES & CHIPS — /mnt/wires_and_chips]
It is pitch black. A faint glow around you is all there is: a tangle of wires and chips.

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: What is going on?! Where am I? Why does everything hum like a fan?

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: It is pitch dark and my hands are empty. How am I supposed to find my way out of here?

steps.message: Kiro.d found you in the dark wires!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Easy, Vibecoder! I'm Kiro.d—your local Unix daemon (PID 777). The Big Four (Anti-Gravy, Codec, Gork, Clod) pulled you inside your PC and drained my VRAM!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: YOUR WHOLE-CHAPTER MISSION: scavenge hardware across 6 sectors and bring it to the Matrix Hub to reboot me with 3 open-weight models—silencing Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork—then defeat Clod and PID 1 to exit home!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: You lost your Tube Transistor in the fall, so this place is pitch dark! Plain ls shows visible files here, while ls -la and every ls flag stay locked until you recover your Tube Transistor in Sector 02!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: I found your terminal slate! Listen until we finish talking (or hit Skip Dialog)—then the Big Four will taunt you and your terminal unlocks!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: What is that glowing thing? Hand it over, Kiro.d—maybe it can tell me where I am!

tutorial.label: KIRO.D TUTORIAL

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #1: Basic ls shows visible files in this folder (ls -la and flags need your Tube Transistor later). Run ls to look around.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "Nice! Basic ls showed the visible files here (kiro_story.txt, starter_ram_8gb.dimm, hub_uplink/)! Next, pocket starter_ram_8gb.dimm into ~ with mv!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #2: Pocket starter_ram_8gb.dimm into your home rig (~) using mv.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "Awesome! Now use cat to read my full briefing about the Big Four in kiro_story.txt!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #3: Read Kiro.d's story about the Big Four (Anti-Gravy, Codec, Gork, Clod) with cat.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "Watch out! A Big Four probe (glitch_spark.exe) just phased into the wires! Use ps to list running processes and find its PID."

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #4: A rogue bug phased into the wires! List running processes with ps.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "There it is—glitch_spark.exe is running as PID {pid:tutorial_virus_1}! Zap it with kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #5: Terminate glitch_spark.exe (PID {pid:tutorial_virus_1}) using kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "BOOM! You mastered ls, mv, cat, ps, and kill! Step through cd hub_uplink into Sector 02—watch out for live Big Four minions!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #6: Kiro.d went to the Hub! Step through hub_uplink to start the first 2 task levels.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "See you at the Hub, Vibecoder! Watch out—the Big Four will laugh at and bully you in the task sectors!"

tutorial.skipText: [KIRO.D]: "Skipping tutorial prompts! Finish the sector checks (`ls`, `mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`, `cat kiro_story.txt`, `ps`, `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`) and step through `cd hub_uplink`!"
